statement.name: GetCurrentNote

(CASE WHEN ISNULL(PPC.MiddleName,'') != '' THEN ISNULL(PPC.FirstName,'') + ' ' + PPC.MiddleName + ' ' + ISNULL(PPC.LastName,'') ELSE ISNULL(PPC.FirstName,'') + ' ' + ISNULL(PPC.LastName,'') END) AS CreatorName,

-1 as versionId, nd.EntityTrackingNumber as ResourceTrackingNumber, nd.EntityType, nd.QueryStrings
FROM PFM_Note_P NT JOIN LU_PFM_NoteType LNT ON NT.NoteTypeCode = LNT.LookupCode LEFT JOIN People PPC ON NT.CreatorId = PPC.UserId LEFT JOIN People PPU ON NT.LastUpdateId = PPU.UserId LEFT JOIN PFM_NoteDetails_P nd on nd.NoteDetailsId = NT.NoteId
